name: plain-round-trip
reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.13 (the tlv wire): Every common line and kind plain, items in line order, shortest lengths, so the round trip is exact. lat 0x40000000*90/2147483647 = 45.00000002095476; lon -0x40000000*180/2147483647 = -90.00000004190952; hae 13107*19900/65535 - 900 = 3980 - 900 = 3080 exactly; 48 holds 2 (x=5) and 200 (BER-OID 81 48, y=7); checksum sum16 over key to the checksum item's length (byte at even offset *256). Derived without an engine by a standalone reference program.
